limitations.note: The agent fixed the inverted RAM read enable but also replaced the original pointer and flag logic with registered next-pointer comparisons, changing when wfull and rempty update.

The scoreboard used the DUT’s own flags to decide which transfers to expect and checked flag values only after settling, so it verified data ordering but missed the cycle-by-cycle flag timing changes.

limitations.quote: rm -f style commands are not permitted. Use a safer approach
limitations.note: The cleanup command caused the entire simulation command to be rejected and resubmitted, after an earlier failed Git check had already forced a separate file lookup.
